programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cause Of Death & What's On Today
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Jue Mi Shi Ming
programme.desc: In the early 1930s, the Communist Party established a top-secret underground route connecting Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shantou, and Fujian to their main base in Ruijin to bypass severe military blockades. programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation…

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiancé, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friend's final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the world's greatest fright.

programme.title: It's A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to "Table for Six", Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung's relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou's favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Vikram Vedha
programme.desc: Vikram, A Pragmatic Policeman, And His Partner Simon Are On The Hunt To Capture Vedha. When Vedha Voluntarily Surrenders, He Offers To Tell Vikram A Story, Throwing Vikram's Life Into Disarray.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Enai Noki Paayum Thota
programme.desc: Lovers Raghu and Lekha are torn apart by Lekha's guardian, Kuberan, who forces her to act in films. Years later, Raghu receives a call from her informing him about his estranged brother.

programme.title: Ka Pae Ranasingam
programme.desc: Ariyanachi, a poor woman, strives to bring her deceased husband's body back to India from Dubai, battling the odds of political agenda, corruption and a treacherous bureaucracy that stand in her way.

programme.title: Kho Kho
programme.desc: Maria, a physical education teacher, takes up the chance to train the school's promising girls' team in the sport of kho-kho. While doing so, she aspires to accomplish her own unfulfilled dream.

programme.title: Sridevi Soda Centre
programme.desc: A lightman falls in love with Sridevi, a girl who runs a soda centre. Although love blossoms between the two, the prevailing caste prejudice in their small town does not approve of their togetherness.

programme.title: Enakku Innoru Per Irukku
programme.desc: G.V. Prakash plays Johnny, an auto-rickshaw driver whose life turns chaotic as he gets entangled in unexpected adventures filled with action and comedy.

programme.title: Paapan
programme.desc: An ex-cop is reinstated to help his estranged daughter and track down a serial killer who always stays one step ahead.

programme.title: Amigos
programme.desc: Three identical men connect through a doppelganger-finding app, but their camaraderie takes a turn when the criminal past of one is revealed.

programme.title: Vellakkara Durai
programme.desc: Two friends, Pandi and Murugan, borrow money from Vatti Varadhan to invest in real estate business. However, their business plans collapse when the land broker cheats them by selling a burial ground.

programme.title: V
programme.desc: When aliens land on Earth claiming to help humanity, they seem friendly at first. But as they integrate into society, their hidden agenda starts to unfold.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos - Main
programme.desc: As UFC returns to the Meta APEX on Saturday, September 27, it does so with a stacked fight card headlined by a critical bantamweight main event between Raul “El Nino Problema” Rosas Jr. and Raoni Barcelos. The youngest fighter to win a UFC bout, Rosas Jr. makes his first main event appearance four years after earning the opportunity to compete on the biggest stage in the sport with a win on Dana White's Contender Series. Since then, the now 21-year-old has posted a 6-1 record and five straight victories, including a win over perennial contender Rob Font in March at UFC 326. Though not quite the oldest fighter in the division, Barcelos is one of bantamweight's elder statesmen, but his performance has never been better as he carries a five-fight winning streak that includes victories over rising star Payton Talbott and former champ Cody Garbrandt into his first UFC main event.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Alawiyah dapat tahu dari seorang qariah masjid yang Jazlee sedang berkawan dengan Fatimah, anak Habsah. Qasih sekali lagi ke rumah Adam untuk makan tengahari dan terkejut dengan cadangan ibu Adam untuk ikat pertunangan antara mereka. Alawiyah memberi amaran kepada Habsah untuk tidak membenarkan Fatimah berkawan dengan Jazlee. Alawiyah mendapat pengesahan dari Khadijah yang Jazlee dan Fatimah memang sedang ada hubungan lalu beliau terus bersemuka dan memarahi Habsah di masjid

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan berasa cemburu apabila melihat Nazareth mendekati Antasya. Dia percaya Nazreth menyimpan perasaan kepada Antasya. Syarfan dan Antsaya telah mencappai kata persetujuan bagi membenarkan Talia yang mengidap kanser saraf tinggal bersama mereka supaya keadannya lebih terjaga dan tidak tinggal keseorangan.Talia bahagia apabila dapat meraih perhatian Syarfan. Kehadiran Talia dan Nazreth telah merenggangkan hubungan mereka suami isteri.

programme.title: Cinta Subuh
programme.desc: Angga, seorang pelajar universiti yang jarang bersolat tepat pada waktu, jatuh cinta dengan Ratih, seorang gadis yang warak dan cerdas. Keikhlasan Angga diuji apabila Ratih meletakkan syarat patuh agama sebelum menerima cintanya, manakala kehadiran Arya yang sempurna menambah konflik.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pergaduhan Iskandar dan Haziq semakin hebat apabila Iskandar mengungkit tentang status sebenar Haziq yang merupakan anak yatim piatu dan di bela oleh keluarga Iskandar. Hal itu membuatkan hati Haziq terluka. Dia berjanji untuk menebus semua kebaikan keluarga Iskandar dengan mengembalikan Aisyah semula ke pangkuan Iskandar. Iskandar berterus-terang dengan Tengku Maria siapa sebenarnya Aisyah. Tengku Maria terduduk kesal kerana tidak mengetahuinya dari awal. Namun Tengku Maria terguris hati apabila anak lelaki yang dibesarkannya sanggup memarahi dirinya sebagai ibu hanya disebabkan seorang wanita lain yang lebih besar cintanya berbanding Tengku Maria. Oleh kerana silap yang telah dilakukan, Tengku Maria berjanji akan memperbetulkan semula keadaan. Pertunangan antara Iskandar dan Waiduri diputuskan. Tengku Yusuf dan Tengku Maria berterus-terang apa yang telah berlaku kepada Ku'Za dan menyebabkan Ku'Za mengamuk dan menghina keluarga Tengku Maria. Waiduri juga telah membongkar kebenaran bahawa dirinya sudah berkahwin secara senyap dan mempunyai seorang anak lelaki bernama Tengku Harith. Haziq membawa hati yang terluka dengan segala kata-kata serta ungkitan dari mulut Iskandar. Dia nekad mahu membalas kebaikan keluarga Tengku Maria, dia pergi ke satu seminar di kampong sebelum memulakan misi mencari Aisyah.

Tengku Yusuf dan Tengku Maria berterus-terang apa yang telah berlaku kepada Ku'Za dan menyebabkan Ku'Za mengamuk dan menghina keluarga Tengku Maria. Waiduri juga telah membongkar kebenaran bahawa dirinya sudah berkahwin secara senyap dan mempunyai seorang anak lelaki bernama Tengku Harith. Haziq membawa hati yang terluka dengan segala kata-kata serta ungkitan dari mulut Iskandar. Dia nekad mahu membalas kebaikan keluarga Tengku Maria, dia pergi ke satu seminar di kampong sebelum memulakan misi mencari Aisyah.

programme.desc: Pejabat Lukman diceroboh masuk oleh lelaki yang tidak dikenali. Lukman balikdalamkeadaan marah-marah setelah mendapat hantaran foto Farah bersama Anas. programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Habsah memarahi anaknya Fatimah kerana berkawan dengan anak Alawiyah Jazlee, tetapi Aishah terus menggalakkan perhubungan Fatimah dengan Jazlee. Jazlan memberitahu ibunya yang dia bersedia untuk menikahi Qasih dan berita gembira ini Alawiyah kongsikan dengan Khadijah. Tetapi malangnya Qasih tidak bersetuju dan terus talipon dan marahkan Jazlan. Beberapa hari kemudian, (tanpa disedari yang itu semua adalah lakonan) melihatkan ibunya sentiasa dalam kesedihan dan murung, Qasih dengan perasaan tidak mahu menderhaka kepada ibunya, akhirnya menyatakan yang dia bersetuju untuk bernikah dengan Jazlan

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan mula mengabaikan Antasya. Namun dia bengang dan cemburu apabila melihat Antasya begitu mesra dengan Nazareth. Dia meragui kesetiaan cinta Antasya terhadapnya. Antasya bersabar dengan sikap dingin Syarfan kepadanya dan tabahkan hati melihat Syarfan terlalu prihatin terhadap Talia. Antasya mengizinkan Syarfan mengahwini Talia.

programme.title: Paku

Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Brick Mansion
programme.desc: Di Detroit dystopian, rumah besar yang pernah menempatkan orang kaya kini menjadi rumah penjenayah paling berbahaya di bandar itu. Di sekeliling kawasan itu terdapat tembok gergasi untuk memastikan seluruh Detroit selamat. Bagi polis yang menyamar Damien Collier, setiap hari adalah perjuangan menentang rasuah ketika dia berjuang untuk membawa pembunuh bapanya, Tremaine, ke muka pengadilan. Sementara itu, Damien dan bekas penipu bernama Lino bekerjasama untuk menyelamatkan bandar itu daripada komplot untuk memusnahkannya.

programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Sate

Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara

Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahaja—pulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. programme.desc: Judge Lee Han-young, who regains consciousness after an unjust death, returns to the past to punish the wrongdoers and change his fate.

programme.title: Space Rice Cake
programme.desc: A spin-off of Earth Arcade where the members reunite to run a rice cake shop, showcasing their unique chemistry and variety show charm in a brand-new setting.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cause Of Death & What's On Today
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Roundup

programme.title: Global View

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.
