programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Fei's ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish…

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: YUM is a detective agency that handles supernatural cases. As YUM investigates the evil spirits appearing in an old building, they discover that the spirits are created by a spirit master to haunt the residents so that the building can be vacated for redevelopment. Can the YUM investigators finally find ways to fight against the master?

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girl's suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: A Gilded Game
programme.desc: Ambitious finance student Gao lands an internship as his friend's family business prepares to go public in H.K. Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friend's company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boy's dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wang's which seem to be related to the accident.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s' Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the city's renowned “Dumpling Queen”.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire
programme.desc: This is a horror comedy about Sifu, Charlie Jiang, and his team of vampire hunters taking on the Vampire King who has been let loose on the streets of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and it's so filled with "don't-blink-or-you-will-miss-something" gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: Finger Of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous “Finger of Doom”, a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos - Main
programme.desc: As UFC returns to the Meta APEX on Saturday, September 27, it does so with a stacked fight card headlined by a critical bantamweight main event between Raul “El Nino Problema” Rosas Jr. and Raoni Barcelos. The youngest fighter to win a UFC bout, Rosas Jr. makes his first main event appearance four years after earning the opportunity to compete on the biggest stage in the sport with a win on Dana White's Contender Series. Since then, the now 21-year-old has posted a 6-1 record and five straight victories, including a win over perennial contender Rob Font in March at UFC 326. Though not quite the oldest fighter in the division, Barcelos is one of bantamweight's elder statesmen, but his performance has never been better as he carries a five-fight winning streak that includes victories over rising star Payton Talbott and former champ Cody Garbrandt into his first UFC main event.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Habsah memarahi anaknya Fatimah kerana berkawan dengan anak Alawiyah Jazlee, tetapi Aishah terus menggalakkan perhubungan Fatimah dengan Jazlee. Jazlan memberitahu ibunya yang dia bersedia untuk menikahi Qasih dan berita gembira ini Alawiyah kongsikan dengan Khadijah. Tetapi malangnya Qasih tidak bersetuju dan terus talipon dan marahkan Jazlan. Beberapa hari kemudian, (tanpa disedari yang itu semua adalah lakonan) melihatkan ibunya sentiasa dalam kesedihan dan murung, Qasih dengan perasaan tidak mahu menderhaka kepada ibunya, akhirnya menyatakan yang dia bersetuju untuk bernikah dengan Jazlan

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan mula mengabaikan Antasya. Namun dia bengang dan cemburu apabila melihat Antasya begitu mesra dengan Nazareth. Dia meragui kesetiaan cinta Antasya terhadapnya. Antasya bersabar dengan sikap dingin Syarfan kepadanya dan tabahkan hati melihat Syarfan terlalu prihatin terhadap Talia. Antasya mengizinkan Syarfan mengahwini Talia.

programme.title: Analisa Anna Lisa
programme.desc: Anna Lisa, seorang suri rumah, menyiasat kematian misteri jirannya melalui podcast jenayah bersama dua wanita lain. Dalam mencari kebenaran, dia berdepan ugutan, pengkhianatan dan kehilangan, namun akhirnya menemui semula tujuan hidupnya.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Kenangan Puan Ainon dan Encik Latiff benar-benar membahagiakan Aisyah yang kini hilang ingatan dan hidup di bawah nama seorang NUR. Rokiah dan Sarip sering datang menjenguk Aisyah di rumah Anim dan Azri, ini membuatkan Aisyah yang hidup dengan nama NUR seperti merasai semula kasih sayang dari kedua ibu bapanya yang sudah meninggal dunia. Aisyah begitu bahagia sehingga dirinya bertemu dengan Haziq. Tanpa sengaja, selepas pulang dari seminar di sebuah kampong, Haziq ternampak akan Aisyah di kawasan sawah padi bersama Amani, Rokiah dan Sarip. Di situ Haziq mengekori Aisyah yang berselisih dengannya tetapi tidak mengenali Haziq. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk bermalam di kampong itu, dia tidak percaya Aisyah tidak lagi mengenalinya. Haziq begitu yakin wanita yang dijumpainya itu Aisyah. Pada keesokan hari, Haziq datang semula ke sawah padi dan menegur Amani, Haziq bertanya terus akan Aisyah namun jawapan yang diberikan oleh Amani mengecewakan Haziq. Haziq meminta Amani membawanya ke rumah untuk bertemu Aisyah dan di situ Haziq bertemu dengan Anim Azri. Anim dan Azri menceritakan segalanya-galanya tentang Aisyah dan nama NUR itu diberi oleh kerana Aisyah tidak dapat mengingati namanya sendiri. Haziq lega akhirnya dia berjumpa dengan Aisyah, dia meminta izin untuk membawa Aisyah pulang namunh Aisyah menolak keras dan tidak mahu berpisah dengan Rokiah, Sarip, Anim, Azri dan Amani yang member sinar bahagia buat dirinya.

Rokiah dan Sarip sering datang menjenguk Aisyah di rumah Anim dan Azri, ini membuatkan Aisyah yang hidup dengan nama NUR seperti merasai semula kasih sayang dari kedua ibu bapanya yang sudah meninggal dunia. Aisyah begitu bahagia sehingga dirinya bertemu dengan Haziq. Tanpa sengaja, selepas pulang dari seminar di sebuah kampong, Haziq ternampak akan Aisyah di kawasan sawah padi bersama Amani, Rokiah dan Sarip. Di situ Haziq mengekori Aisyah yang berselisih dengannya tetapi tidak mengenali Haziq. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk bermalam di kampong itu, dia tidak percaya Aisyah tidak lagi mengenalinya. Haziq begitu yakin wanita yang dijumpainya itu Aisyah. Pada keesokan hari, Haziq datang semula ke sawah padi dan menegur Amani, Haziq bertanya terus akan Aisyah namun jawapan yang diberikan oleh Amani mengecewakan Haziq. Haziq meminta Amani membawanya ke rumah untuk bertemu Aisyah dan di situ Haziq bertemu dengan Anim Azri. Anim dan Azri menceritakan segalanya-galanya tentang Aisyah dan nama NUR itu diberi oleh kerana Aisyah tidak dapat mengingati namanya sendiri. Haziq lega akhirnya dia berjumpa dengan Aisyah, dia meminta izin untuk membawa Aisyah pulang namunh Aisyah menolak keras dan tidak mahu berpisah dengan Rokiah, Sarip, Anim, Azri dan Amani yang member sinar bahagia buat dirinya.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan mula mengabaikan Antasya. Namun dia bengang dan cemburu apabila melihat Antasya begitu mesra dengan Nazareth. Dia meragui kesetiaan cinta Antasya terhadapnya. Antasya bersabar dengan sikap dingin Syarfan kepadanya dan tabahkan hati melihat Syarfan terlalu prihatin terhadap Talia. Antasya mengizinkan Syarfan mengahwini Talia.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Habsah memarahi anaknya Fatimah kerana berkawan dengan anak Alawiyah Jazlee, tetapi Aishah terus menggalakkan perhubungan Fatimah dengan Jazlee. Jazlan memberitahu ibunya yang dia bersedia untuk menikahi Qasih dan berita gembira ini Alawiyah kongsikan dengan Khadijah. Tetapi malangnya Qasih tidak bersetuju dan terus talipon dan marahkan Jazlan. Beberapa hari kemudian, (tanpa disedari yang itu semua adalah lakonan) melihatkan ibunya sentiasa dalam kesedihan dan murung, Qasih dengan perasaan tidak mahu menderhaka kepada ibunya, akhirnya menyatakan yang dia bersetuju untuk bernikah dengan Jazlan

programme.title: Rojak
programme.desc: Dihoskan oleh Leaism, beliau akan melakukan aktiviti yang tidak pernah beliau cuba, mencuba makanan baharu, dan berkongsi pengetahuan am. Selain itu, terdapat juga segmen melibatkan respondan luar iaitu Cabaran dan juga Soalan Rawak.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Gambar Khai melamar Deanna tular di media sosial dan Deanna kini dianggap curang. Deanna cuba memulihkan keadaan tetapi sedar dia tidak akan jumpa jalannya selagi tidak menjawab satu soalan: Adakah dia akan memilih Mat atau Khai?

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah terkejut melihat sepasang kasut perempuan di luar pintu rumah Lukman. Farahhilang sabar dan 'naik hantu' sebaik melihat Myra ada di ruang tamu. FarahdenganMyra bertengkar. Namun, Farah lebih sentap apabila Lukman seakan menyebelahi Myra. Kak Yati seakan tidak percaya dengan aduan Farah dan menganggap ada salah faham.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Qasih terpaksa berterus terang dengan Adam yang beliau akan berkahwin dengan Jazlan tak lama lagi dan perhubungan mereka perlu dihentikan. Dan berita ini juga membuatkan Aisyah meroyan dan terus ke rumah Alawiyah untuk meyakinkan Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu dan apabila Jazlan sampai dari Mesir Aisyah terus meluru masuk ke rumah Alawiyah dan sekali lagi meminta Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu bukan Qasih. Jazlan pula teringat akan kata-kata Qasih semasa memarahi beliau kerana bersetuju untuk berkahwin dengannya lalu Jazlan terus memaklumkan kepada ibunya untuk membatalkan pernikahannya dengan Qasih

programme.title: Kahwin 5
programme.desc: Dr K (Usop Wilcha) ialah seorang usahawan mangkuk plastik dari Perak yang sudah mempunyai empat isteri dari negeri berbeza (Selangor, Kelantan, Negeri Sembilan, Sabah). Kehidupannya tenang hingga dia terlibat dengan skandal bersama Farra, seorang setiausaha muda yang bersaudara dengan ketua gangster, Cico. Dr K ditekan untuk berkahwin lagi - mencetus dilema: kekalkan empat isteri atau cerai salah seorang demi menyelamatkan nyawa

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP10
programme.desc: McCall bergabung tenaga dengan Jessie Cook, seorang pencuri bijak dan tidak dapat diramal, untuk mendapatkan semula lukisan berharga yang dicuri daripada sebuah keluarga Kulit Hitam semasa Pembunuhan Beramai-ramai Tulsa 1921.

programme.title: Mummy Reborn
programme.desc: Apabila sekumpulan remaja dalam kemusnahan kewangan memutuskan untuk merompak kedai antik tempatan, mereka menemui sebuah kubur kayu lama yang mengandungi mayat Mumia dan azimat purba. Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. Pencuri kita mesti menyelamatkan hari ini dan mengembalikan Mumia ke kuburnya sebelum terlambat untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langit—yang mampu mengawal minda manusia—enam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Munafik
programme.desc: Adam merupakan seorang pengamal perubatan Islam yang tidak dapat menerima hakikat isterinya sudah tiada di dunia ini. Kemudian, dia bersetuju untuk merawat seorang wanita yang tertekan bernama Maria tetapi perkara aneh dan meresahkan mula berlaku.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Kanang Anak Langkau
programme.desc: Sebuah filem berdasarkan kisah benar Sarjan Kanang Anak Langkau, seorang pahlawan iban dan pahlawan perang yang paling terkenal di negara ini, yang berjuang dengan berani semasa pemberontakan komunis.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 1
programme.desc: Abang Long Fadil, seorang lelaki yang sentiasa berangan bahawa kehidupannya seperti seorang gangster. Tetapi apabila sahabat baiknya, Malik dimasukkan ke penjara, lebih banyak kekacauan berlaku dan angan-angannya mungkin tidak jauh berbeza daripada realiti.

programme.title: Black S2 EP4
programme.desc: Black menolong Sofia menyelamatkan seseorang yang rapat dengan Sofia tapi itu hanya menyebabkan mereka hampir maut. Semuanya tampak ada kaitan dengan runtuhan Pusat Membeli-Belah Seri Setia.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China And America
programme.desc: Berikutan serangan hendap dalam lawatannya ke Amerika, Wong Fei-hung terpisah daripada rakan-rakan pengembaranya dan mengalami kehilangan ingatan.

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Kisah ahli perniagaan London yang rendah hati Quan, yang masa lalunya yang telah lama terkubur meletus dalam dendam yang didorong oleh dendam apabila satu-satunya orang yang ditinggalkan untuk dicintainya - anak perempuan remajanya - diambil daripadanya dalam tindakan keganasan bermotif politik yang tidak masuk akal . Dalam pencarian tanpa henti untuk identiti pengganas, Quan terpaksa terlibat dalam konflik kucing-dan-tikus dengan seorang pegawai kerajaan Ireland, yang masa lalunya mungkin mengandungi petunjuk tentang identiti pembunuh yang sukar difahami.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP1
programme.desc: Long Samad kemudian menceritakan kisah Zufar dan Rihana. Zufar bertemu dengan Rihana secara tidak sengaja dan tertarik dengan gadis itu. Tanpa mengetahui rahsia besar yang disembunyikan keluarga Rihana, Zufar akhirnya memilih untuk berkahwin dengannya walaupun mendapat tentangan daripada ibunya, Zahrah, dan adiknya, Lia.Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

Malah gadis bernama Natasya itu juga gigih mahu memperjuangkan dan membangunkan anak bangsanya terutama penduduk tempatan supaya berjaya dan membangun seiring dengan perkembangan dunia luar. Begitu pun tanggungjawabnya bukan mudah kerana keadaan di Bosnia Herzegovina bukan mudah untuk seorang wanita terutama anak gadis mendapat pendidikan di luar negara untuk berperanan di negara sendiri.

Program ini menceritakan tazkirah yang disampaikan berdasarkan topik-topik mengenai kehidupan kita di dalam Islam. Melalui program ini penonton akan dapat pelbagai info dan ilmu tentang ciri, matlamat dan tujuan dalam kehidupan seharian kita.

programme.title: Jejak Rasul - Nabi Muhammad SAW
programme.desc: Episod ini menceritakan keperibadian Nabi sebagai seorang suami dan bapa. Nabi meninggalkan contoh teladan sebagai sunnah yang menjadi panduan umatnya yang beriman. Diceritakan Nabi sebagai hamba dan kekasih Allah yang dijanjikan syurga namun masih sering menangis dan bertaubat kepada tuhannya. Turut diselitkan juga kisah 4 sahabat Baginda.

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi

Sunnah Nabi merupakan program keagamaan yang membawakan perbincangan santai namun ilmiah mengenai amalan sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian umat Islam. Program ini menampilkan pelbagai topik umum dan khusus berkaitan sunnah.

programme.title: Tok Guru
programme.desc: Di sekolah melayu terdapat seorang cikgu mengajar bahasa inggeris yang asal usul keturunannya berasal dari Ceylon. Semua yang di sekolah pondok tidak tahu di manakah Ceylon. Cikgu Roslan mengajar mereka kedudukan Ceylon dan mereka semua teruja dapat mengenali dunia luar.

programme.title: Deko Ibadah
programme.desc: Team Deko Ibadah kali ini berada di Surau Al-Hidayah, Kg Sembilan Tengkera. Deko Ibadah berkongsi inspirasi menghias dan menyusun ruang ibadah yang selesa, praktikal serta menenangkan. Menggabungkan elemen dekorasi dan pengisian Islam, program ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran yang lebih kondusif untuk beribadah dan menghayati nilai-nilai murni.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Daus berdepan dengan Mia dan meminta penjelasan apakah benar Mia anak haram dan merupakan bekas banduan dan penagih dadah. Mia terpaksa mengakui tetapi memberitahu dia sudah meninggalkan semua itu. Daus tidak percaya. Dia menuduh Mia menipu dan menuduh Mia menggunakannya untuk menutup salah laku lampaunya. Mia menafikan dan bersumpah yang dia benar-benar menyintai Daus. Daus meninggalkan Mia sendirian di pulau itu dan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur dengan hati yang luka.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Jamil dibawa oleh Qistina untuk bertemu dengan Datuk King. Mereka bertemu di sebuah syarikat besar. Datuk King masih mengenangkan kebaikan Jamil yang pernah selamatkan nyawa adiknya. Namun sebenarnya Jamil tidak tahu bahawa Datuk King dan Qistina sudah sepakat untuk mengenakan Jamil. Qistina mencadangkan untuk Jamil menukar pakaian lain yang lebih nampak segak. Jamil minta baju zaman 60annya semula. Namun Qistina menghalang dan minta pengawal peribadi untuk beri pakaian persis seperti seorang CEO. Selepas menukar pakaian, Jamil terasa dirinya kacak dan dia mula berjalan megah mengalahkan Tan Sri.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantu­nya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahaja—pulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cause Of Death & What's On Today
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7)
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. Each episode features celebrity guests divided into two teams, each using their imagination to solve incredibly difficult puzzles related to the hilarious clips alongside the leader. They can also ask two beautiful "fun agents" for hints, but they'll have to judge for themselves which information is true and which is false. The worst-performing guest will receive "retraining" from the leader—what punishment awaits the guests?

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: Cherry is a young girl addicted to the internet. After seeing a warning video about an “e-ghost” on YouTube, she begins to encounter many mysterious incidents, and the “e-ghost” also takes control of her family. Cherry must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world...

programme.title: Let's Get Rich
programme.desc: The Jia family, a group of talented Taiwanese con artists, is recruited by a fraudster to expose a corrupt tech tycoon's Ponzi scheme and to steal millions from him through a complex deception plan.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: Adapted from a sensational 2013 parricide in Hong Kong, a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, the defendants play the devil and idiot game, while the defense attorneys turn on each other. Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: One Second
programme.desc: Directed by renowned director Zhang Yimou, the film is set during the Cultural Revolution, where a common man escapes a labour camp to find a newsreel that captures his daughter for one second in a movie. On the way, he encounters an orphan who also seeks the movie reel. Can the man finally pass the reel to a projectionist and screen the movie?

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Daily's Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the defence of the Great Wall at Gubeikou, seven Chinese soldiers are separated from their main force and tasked with defending the strategic outpost of Badaolouzi. Vastly outnumbered by Japanese troops and tanks, they make a last stand, fighting to the end in a powerful display of sacrifice and patriotism.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a snake. Wang's exorcist sister (Hsia Ping), who performs rites for him, also dies in an accident. And so does a fortune-teller who refused to read May's fortune.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Kid With The Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yang's employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal…

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming's overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the “Toad Stance” and accidentally unveils his true identity…

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.desc: After a series of murders take place one after another, a police officer decides to investigate the case himself and bring the killer to justice.

programme.desc: Ray, bekas playboy, melamar tunangnya Khadeja. Namun ibunya, Dato' Shikin - seorang ibu tunggal dan peguam - menetapkan syarat unik untuk restu: Ray mesti meminta maaf secara peribadi kepada 11 bekas teman wanitanya, merakam momen itu dalam tempoh 30 hari

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP5
programme.desc: Zacky terkesan dengan kematian adiknya Aeera. Dia menyalahkan Ritz dan Affiyah atas apa yang berlaku. Tindakan Rafeeq cuba membunuh Affiyah tergendala dengan kemunculan seorang jururawat. Affiyah yang terlantar dihospital akhirnya meninggal setelah diganggu dengan mimpi ngeri serta mimpi bertemu arwah ibunya.Ritz bersedih atas pemergian adiknya dan Zacky pula terbaring tidak sedarkan diri menerima berita tentang Affiyah. Rafeeq mula terasa kesal atas perbuatannya terhadap Affiyah selama ini

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China III
programme.desc: Tuan Wong dan pengikutnya mendaftar dalam 'Dancing Lion Competition' untuk menghentikan plot pembunuhan dan melawan lawan yang sombong dan penipu.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantu­nya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahaja—pulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Ganteng Sih Tapi Sayang Udah Makan Belum?
programme.desc: Bella (Ochi Rosdiana), seorang gadis cantik dan berada, secara tidak sengaja bertemu Ahong (El Ryan Carlen) yang sedang melarikan diri daripada Wina, seorang wanita yang meminatinya. Pertemuan mereka bermula dengan pertengkaran apabila Ahong terlanggar Bella, namun kejadian itu menjadi permulaan kepada hubungan yang tidak pernah mereka jangkakan.

programme.title: Foodie Buddy
programme.desc: Program masakan dan kulinari yang meneroka keunikan serta kekayaan cita rasa hidangan Indonesia, menampilkan pelbagai sajian tradisional, ramuan tempatan dan pengalaman kulinari dari seluruh negara.

programme.title: Gaspol

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: THE KING

programme.title: SORI: VOICE FROM THE HEART

programme.title: THE WHISTLEBLOWER

programme.desc: Four lifelong friends reunite for a long-postponed trip to Thailand. An uninvited guest suddenly joins in and their 'dream trip' begins spiraling into total, glorious chaos.

programme.title: THE SNITCH
programme.desc: Kang-soo was falsely accused and imprisoned. A prosecutor offered him a deal to be a snitch in exchange for a reduced sentence and Kang-soo starts to shake up the drug investigation...

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cause Of Death & What's On Today
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show "Mean Talk" hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most "Mean" way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as "Mean Talk," guests must lower their standards and be "Mean" to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a "Mean Confession Voucher," promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing (Sammy) has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan (Priscilla Wong), causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai (KK Cheung), Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei (Zoie Tam). Gold digger Tong Mei-fun (Kamen Kong) is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai (Daniel Chau) and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngai's real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.
